name: StegBrowser Runtime Consumption
purpose: Execute the manifest-declared StegBrowser owned mirror route through the existing Canonical Work and Interlock/InTr runtime-consumption chain on an admitted ephemeral StegOS node without creating a duplicate runtime, scheduler, WorkerCoordinator, credential path, or device dependency.
trigger: STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-MATERIALIZATION-REMEDIATION-001 is ACTIVE/CHECKED_OUT and its complete manifest is bound to COSV 40000100100000; STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-CONSUMPTION-001 remains retired historical operation lineage and is not reactivated
scope: one manifest-bound invocation for STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-MATERIALIZATION-REMEDIATION-001 / COSV 40000100100000 using the declared StegVerse-owned mirror route
reuse_instructions: Trigger once through scripts/trigger_reusable_task.py against the active remediation Goal STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-MATERIALIZATION-REMEDIATION-001 / COSV 40000100100000. scripts/run_stegbrowser_manifest_bound_runtime.py must validate and bind the exact declared manifest before invoking the existing runtime-consumption runner. The manifest declares the outbound Interlock/InTr endpoint, StegVerse-owned mirror reflector, Round Trip 1 recording return, mirror-processing boundary, Round Trip 2 Interlock/InTr endpoint, and final ecosystem receiver. Endpoint or receiver discovery/substitution is prohibited. Interlock/InTr still governs whether each declared transition is allowed. Round Trip 1 ends with the returned records packet durably recorded for verification; Master Records/mirror processing then occurs between trips; Round Trip 2 returns from the mirror boundary through endpoint Interlock/InTr into the ecosystem. Source or CI state must never be promoted to runtime completion evidence.
